    • getQualifyUsernameWithProvider

      @NonNull default @NonNull Optional<Boolean> getQualifyUsernameWithProvider()
      Whether the username of an Authentication built from an OpenID provider response, by the default OpenIdAuthenticationMapper at login or by the UserInfo endpoint token validator, is qualified with the provider name, as providerName:subject, instead of being the bare sub claim. The sub claim is only unique within one provider, so an unqualified username lets a user at one provider share identity with a user at another provider which issued the same sub.
      Returns:
      true to always qualify the username, false to never qualify it, or empty to qualify only when more than one enabled OAuth 2.0 client, other than client-credentials-only clients, is configured under micronaut.security.oauth2.clients
      Since:
      4.18.2
